definition.description: From a tall bilateral stance, rapidly lower without a preparatory jump into a declared athletic squat/landing position, arrive quietly with both feet grounded, hold the terminal position for the declared duration, then stand and reset. One repetition contains one non-jump drop, one bilateral arrival, one stick, and no rebound, step-off, travel, or takeoff.

environment.surface: clean, dry, level, stable, non-slip floor with one body-length of clearance
environment.space: one visible standing station with protected entry and exit
inspection: surface, footwear, clearance, footing, visibility, and stop signal
coach sightline to feet, knees, hips, trunk, and terminal hold
environment.changeRule: Changing start, arm action, support, laterality, surface height, rebound, takeoff, cue, hold, dose, symptoms, or substitute requires revalidation.

selectionPrerequisites: pain-free bodyweight squat and stable bilateral stance
understands tall start, non-jump drop, quiet bilateral arrival, terminal hold, stop signal, and reset
safe floor and session lower-body, impact, technical-fatigue, logistics, and duration budgets fit
excludeOrEscalate: pain, giving way, slip, unsafe floor, repeated heel lift, knee/trunk collapse, rebound, balance loss, or communication conflict
new neurologic, circulation, breathing, chest, balance, or coordination concern
notEstablishedByEvidence: universal depth, arm action, hold, dose, recovery, readiness threshold, clinical clearance, injury outcome, or performance transfer

provenance.identityAuthority: Landing/braking foundations packet: the stable identity is a tall bilateral non-jump rapid lower to a quiet bilateral athletic landing position and terminal stick; arm snap is a modifier, while support, laterality, height, rebound, or takeoff change the task.

anatomy.laterality: bilateral stance and terminal stick; record meaningful asymmetry without assigning athlete skill labels
anatomy.claimsBoundary: Describes task mechanics and plausible loading sites only; it does not diagnose, treat, prevent injury, establish readiness, or guarantee transfer.

athleteSupport.whyItMatters: Candidate practice for finding a quiet, controlled bilateral landing position without adding a jump, rebound, or external-height load.
athleteSupport.primaryCue: Start tall, drop quietly into your landing shape, and freeze the finish.
secondaryCues: bend through ankles, knees, and hips together
keep both feet grounded and knees tracking over the middle toes
arrive without a jump, heel lift, bounce, or extra shift
expectedSensations: light-to-moderate thigh, hip, calf, foot, and trunk control effort
brief attention to quiet position acquisition and balance
unexpectedSensations: pain, giving way, heel lift, knee/trunk collapse, loud contact, imbalance, dizziness, or inability to hold
athleteSupport.painGuidance: Stop rather than forcing depth or a hold through pain, instability, dizziness, or another concerning symptom; report it and follow facility escalation policy.
selfChecks: started tall without a preparatory jump
arrived with both feet grounded and quiet
did not rebound, shift, travel, or take off

observationChecklist: exact non-jump bilateral task, arm-action modifier, surface, clearance, and no-rebound boundary
feet, ankle/knee/hip sharing, knee/trunk control, contact sound, terminal hold, balance, and side asymmetry
valid repetitions, first fault, symptoms, rest, and downstream lower-body exposure

faultCorrections.preparatory_jump: slow the lowering and rehearse a tall non-jump start
faultCorrections.heel_lift_or_reach: reduce depth and restore whole-foot quiet arrival
faultCorrections.knee_or_trunk_collapse: reduce speed or range; stop if aligned control cannot return
faultCorrections.rebound_or_shift: shorten the set and restore a clear terminal hold before counting repetitions

demonstrationPlan: show tall start, quiet bilateral drop, athletic position, declared hold, stand, and reset
show a snap-down arm action as an optional same-identity modifier
show invalid jump, heel lift, collapse, rebound, and extra shift
confirm athlete can state the no-jump/no-rebound boundary and stop signal
groupManagement: one visible station per athlete with clear space
stagger starts so coach can see feet, knees, and terminal hold
record selected arm modifier, valid repetitions, first fault, symptoms, rest, and lower-body exposure
modificationDecisionTree: if pain, giving way, slip, dizziness, unsafe floor, or communication failure occurs, stop and escalate under facility policy
if quiet bilateral arrival or terminal alignment is lost, reduce range or speed only if control returns
if the task needs support, unilateral stance, elevation, rebound, or takeoff, select a separately reviewed exact variant and rerun validation
do not treat a jump, drop from height, or rebound as automatic progression
doNotUseWhen: the intended task is jump landing, elevated step-off, unilateral landing, rebound, vertical takeoff, agility, or conditioning
surface, symptoms, terminal control, supervision, or communication is inadequate

supportOperations.supportEscalation: Stop and escalate unresolved symptoms, unsafe setup, repeated position loss, or a mismatch between the requested task and this exact non-jump bilateral drop-to-stick contract.
supportOperations.retentionPolicy: Persist the versioned definition and exact variant, selected arm action, valid repetitions, hold, range, first fault, contact quality, symptoms, rest, substitution, stop reason, and generator/rendering versions under facility policy.
supportOperations.changeImpactPolicy: Any change to arm action, support, laterality, height, rebound, takeoff, surface, hold, dose, cue, or substitute reruns selection, fatigue, impact, logistics, duration, substitutions, and validation.

sourceVariant.displayName: Drop Squat to Stick Legacy Skeleton — Source 217
sourceVariant.archiveReason: The source lacks a complete non-jump, landing-position, hold, load, fatigue, delivery, alternate, support, and review contract.

legacy.description: Start tall, rapidly lower without jumping, arrive quietly in a bilateral athletic squat/landing position, hold, stand, and reset.
legacy.tempo: tall start; non-jump drop; quiet bilateral arrival; two-second stick; stand/reset
legacy.loadNote: Low external-load, bilateral eccentric position acquisition. Exact depth, arm action, hold, repetitions, rest, and overlap with lower-body work are delivery-profile specific.
legacy.cardSummary: Candidate non-jump bilateral landing-position card with explicit no-jump, no-rebound, terminal-hold, and stop boundaries.
legacy.coachLanguage: Count only quiet, aligned, non-jump arrivals that own the terminal hold.
legacy.athleteLanguage: Start tall, drop quietly, find your landing shape, freeze, stand, and report symptoms.

safety.prerequisiteNotes: Readiness is the exact bilateral non-jump start, landing position, surface, symptom, supervision, and fatigue context—not a participant classification.
readinessChecks: pain-free bodyweight squat and stable bilateral stance
clean dry non-slip floor and clear station
can demonstrate a small quiet bilateral landing shape and terminal hold
session lower-body and impact budgets fit
stopSigns: pain, giving way, slip, heel lift, repeated valgus/collapse, loud uncontrolled contact, imbalance, unsafe station, or participant stop request
inability to hold the terminal position or restore quiet aligned movement after rest
contraindications: symptom, unsafe surface, inadequate bilateral landing control, supervision, or communication
support, unilateral stance, elevation, rebound, takeoff, or assessment intent without a separately reviewed contract
commonSubstitutions: Use another reviewed task only after full revalidation.
Do not automatically substitute a jump, step-off, rebound, unilateral task, or loaded squat.

score.difficultyRationale: The score describes task complexity and physical difficulty for a bilateral non-jump drop-to-stick only, not participant ability, experience, age, or readiness. Timing, position acquisition, alignment, and terminal control exceed its low physical demand.

difficultyProfile.notes: Exact tall bilateral non-jump lower, quiet athletic landing position, terminal stick, no rebound or takeoff.

variants.displayName: Bilateral Non-Jump Drop Squat to Terminal Stick

programmingProfile.weeklyExposure: candidate_review_required; program from current lower-body exposure rather than a universal frequency
prerequisites: safe non-slip station and understood stop signal
programmingProfile.completionCriteria: every repetition starts tall without jumping, arrives quiet and aligned with both feet grounded, holds the terminal shape, and has no stop event
programmingProfile.sequenceRules: Place in preparation or movement intelligence before higher-impact jump, step-off, or change-of-direction work when landing-position quality is the priority.
programmingProfile.pairingCompatibility: May pair with mobility, simple trunk control, or low-fatigue upper-body work when station, recovery, and total lower-body exposure remain valid.
programmingProfile.interferenceRules: Do not stack with high-impact jump, depth-drop, exhaustive lower-body work, or testing when terminal control degrades.
programmingProfile.uncertaintyPolicy: Scores, dose, recovery, and progression are candidate planning estimates; require human review and rerun validation after any change.

deliveryProfiles.purpose: Rehearse quiet bilateral landing position acquisition without a jump or meaningful fatigue.
deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: Start tall without jumping, arrive quietly with both feet grounded and aligned, hold the terminal shape, and show no stop event.
stopRules: pain, instability, slip, unsafe station, or participant request
heel lift, collapse, loud uncontrolled contact, rebound, extra shift, or inability to hold
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Show tall start, non-jump drop, quiet finish, hold, stand, and reset. Count only valid quiet aligned repetitions.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Start tall. Drop into your landing shape without jumping. Land quietly, freeze, stand, and reset.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Task-specific bilateral landing-position rehearsal; no universal outcome is claimed.

logistics.station: one visible clean non-slip floor station
logistics.durationFormula: setup plus valid repetitions, rest, restarts, recording, and reset

doseScaling.range: use a smaller controlled lowering before adding repetitions
doseScaling.volume: add only while every arrival remains quiet, aligned, and still

supportPrompts.athlete: Drop quietly and freeze your landing shape.
supportPrompts.coach: No jump, no bounce; quiet aligned hold.
